mapper.select: select left(sidoCode,2) sidoCode, sidoName from sidocode order by sidoCode
select left(gugunCode,5) gugunCode, gugunName from guguncode where left(gugunCode,2) = #{sido} order by gugunCode
select distinct dongName, dongCode from dongcode where left(dongCode, 5) = #{gugun} and dongName is not null order by dongName

select h.aptCode, h.roadName, h.roadNameBonbun, h.roadNameBubun, h.roadNameSeq, h.roadNameCode, h.bonbun, h.apartmentName, h.buildYear, h.dongCode, h.dong, h.jibun, h.lat, h.lng, si.sidoname, gu.gugunname, (select round(avg(cast(replace(dealAmount, ',' ,'')as unsigned))) from housedeal hd where hd.aptCode=h.aptCode) avgPrice from houseinfo h left join sidocode si on left(h.dongcode,2) = left(si.sidocode,2) left join guguncode gu on left(h.dongcode,5) = left(gu.guguncode,5) where dongCode = #{dong} order by h.apartmentName;

SELECT h.aptCode, h.roadName, h.roadNameBonbun, h.roadNameBubun, h.roadNameSeq, h.roadNameCode, h.bonbun, h.apartmentName, h.buildYear, h.dongCode, h.dong, h.jibun, h.lat, h.lng, si.sidoname, gu.gugunname FROM houseinfo h LEFT JOIN sidocode si ON LEFT(h.dongcode, 2) = LEFT(si.sidocode, 2) LEFT JOIN guguncode gu ON LEFT(h.dongcode, 5) = LEFT(gu.guguncode, 5) WHERE h.apartmentName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{aptName}, '%') ORDER BY h.apartmentName;
select apartmentName from houseinfo where aptCode = #{aptCode};
select aptcode, replace(dealAmount, ',' ,'') dealAmount, dealYear, dealMonth, dealDay, area, floor from housedeal where aptCode = #{aptCode} order by dealYear desc, dealMonth desc, dealDay desc;
select sidoName, gugunName, dongName from dongcode where dongcode = #{dongcode}
